title: IntentGrasp：意图理解综合基准
summary: 提出IntentGrasp基准，用于评估LLM的意图理解能力。包含26万训练样本和两个测试集，对20个LLM评估发现性能不佳。提出Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT)方法，在All Set和Gem Set上分别提升30+和20+F1分，并展现出强跨域泛化能力。
summary_en: Introduces IntentGrasp, a benchmark for evaluating LLM intent understanding. Contains 262K training instances and two test sets. Evaluations on 20 LLMs show poor performance. Proposes Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT), achieving 30+ F1 gains on All Set and 20+ on Gem Set, with strong cross-domain generalization.
